profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software engineer with 20 years of experience in designing, building and debugging system software. Focusing on releasing performant, reliable and efficient software.

Skilled in Rust, C, C++. I have extensive experience optimizing software for resource-limited systems and developing device drivers and firmware.

Outside of work, I enjoy backcountry skiing, cycling, and coffee.

publications.publisher: IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE 2022) · Nov 3, 2022
